name: vscode-yui
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, diagnostics, completions, navigation, live preview, SVG import and tools for coding agents for YUI, the declarative UI language of the YUP library.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the tools for coding agents are not served, documents only read the files of the workspace and of their own folder, and the yui.mcp, yui.lint.models and yui.files.readOutsideWorkspace settings of the workspace are ignored.

yui.lint.enabled.description: Report the problems of .yui documents while editing them.

yui.lint.models.description: Path to a JSON file declaring the application models bound by the documents, absolute or relative to the workspace folder of the linted file. Without it, bindings such as 'value <=> params.cutoff' are reported as unknown elements.

yui.files.readOutsideWorkspace.markdownDescription: **Unsafe.** Read the files a document names wherever they are, such as a font in a folder above the workspace, instead of only in the folders of the workspace and of the document. A document can then have any file you can read loaded to be checked and previewed, so turn it on only for documents you trust. It is ignored in a workspace that is not trusted, and the tools for coding agents stay held to the workspace.

yui.preview.size.patternErrorMessage: Expected auto, panel or <width>x<height> in logical pixels, such as 640x400.
yui.preview.size.description: The size of the preview, also chosen in its toolbar. 'auto' shows an interface at the width and height its root sets, and otherwise at the size of the preview panel. 'panel' is always the size of the panel. Both follow the panel when it is resized. '<width>x<height>' is a fixed size in logical pixels, such as 640x400.

yui.preview.theme.description: The theme the preview is shown with, also chosen in its toolbar.

yui.mcp.enabled.description: Serve the tools for coding agents on this machine: the problems, the layout and an image of a .yui document, over the Model Context Protocol. 'YUI: Set Up Agent Tools' turns it on for a workspace and lists the server in its .mcp.json, with the token it answers for. They are only served from a trusted workspace.

yui.mcp.port.description: The port the tools for coding agents are served on, at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp. Each window serving them needs its own, which 'YUI: Set Up Agent Tools' finds.
